subunit: Interacts with sarcolipin (SLN); the interaction inhibits ATP2A2 Ca(2+) affinity. Interacts with phospholamban (PLN); the interaction inhibits ATP2A2 Ca(2+) affinity. Interacts with myoregulin (MRLN). Interacts with ARLN and ERLN; the interactions inhibit ATP2A2 Ca(2+) affinity. Interacts with STRIT1/DWORF; the interaction results in activation of ATP2A2. Interacts with the monomeric forms of SLN, PLN, ARLN, ERLN and STRI1/DWORF. Interacts with HAX1. Interacts with S100A8 and S100A9. Interacts with SLC35G1 and STIM1. Interacts with TMEM203. Interacts with TMEM64 and PDIA3. Interacts with TMX1. Interacts with TMX2. Interacts with VMP1; VMP1 competes with PLN and SLN to prevent them from forming an inhibitory complex with ATP2A2. Interacts with ULK1. Interacts with S100A1 in a Ca(2+)-dependent manner. Interacts with TUNAR. Interacts with FLVCR2; this interaction occurs in the absence of heme and promotes ATP2A2 proteasomal degradation; this complex is dissociated upon heme binding. Interacts with FNIP1
